The lesion is composed of vascular lakes, interspersed thick-walled vessels, and numerous microvasculature with angiogenic sprouts in a background of fibroadipose tissue. Lymphoid aggregates and a myxoid stroma are present.
The mass is composed of numerous vascular lakes in a background of fibrous and adipose tissue with intervening skeletal muscle. Lymphoid aggregates and rare thick-walled vessels are also present.
It is composed of clusters of cavernous channels, some with intraluminal organizing thrombi.
Intramuscular fast flow vascular anomaly composed of lobules of small vessels with centrally located larger channels in a background of fibrosis and atrophic skeletal muscle.
Intramuscular venous malformation composed of clusters of cavernous channels, some with intraluminal organizing thrombi.

PTEN hamartoma of soft tissue (PHOST) composed of vascular lakes, interspersed thick-walled vessels, and numerous microvasculature with angiogenic sprouts in a background of fibroadipose tissue. Heterotopic ossification, lymphoid aggregates, and myxoid stroma are present.

Intramuscular fibroadipose vascular anomaly (FAVA) composed of numerous vascular lakes in a background of fibrous and adipose tissue with intervening skeletal muscle. Lymphoid aggregates and rare thick-walled vessels are also present.
